title: What to improve this week
headline: Claude proposes **12 changes** to how it works for you: 2 style rules, 3 terms, 2 fixes, 3 tips and 2 new routines.

start_here.title: 12 proposals, about 6 minutes
start_here.why: Start with the two fixes: both come from corrections you made twice this week.

style.rule: Open with the answer, no greeting for people you talk to daily.
style.before: Hi Mia, hope you are well! I wanted to let you know that I can do Thursday at 2.

change.after: Slack DM: open with the answer. No greeting for people the user talks to daily. One line unless asked.

style.impact: Affects every Slack DM draft Claude writes for you.

evidence.quote: Draft: "Hi Mia, hope you are well! I wanted to let you know that I can do Thursday at 2." Sent: "Thursday 2 PM works."
Draft: "Thanks for the update, Jordan. Just wanted to confirm..." Sent: "Ok, ship it."
Draft: "Hi Nora, quick question..." Sent: "Is 1 PM still on?"

style.rule: Use "Hallo" and first names, close with "Viele Grüße" and no summary line.
style.before: Sehr geehrter Herr Brandt, anbei die Zusammenfassung unseres Gesprächs.
style.after: Hallo Jan, anbei die Zahlen. Viele Grüße, Riley

change.after: Email, German: "Hallo <first name>", close with "Viele Grüße", no summary line.

evidence.quote: Draft: "Sehr geehrter Herr Brandt, anbei die Zusammenfassung..." Sent: "Hallo Jan, anbei die Zahlen. Viele Grüße, Riley"
Draft closed with a two-line summary; sent version has none.

glossary.meaning: A partner or vendor asking for a product we have not built yet; logged to rank the roadmap.

change.after: pull signal: a partner or vendor asking for a product we have not built yet; logged to rank the roadmap.

glossary.impact: Brief and radar stop asking what a pull signal is.

evidence.quote: "They want their orders in the API. That counts as a pull signal."
"Log it as a pull signal for the Partner API."

glossary.meaning: Access tier for a dataset in the warehouse (public, internal, restricted), set in the infra change.

change.before: clearance level: a security review stage.
change.after: clearance level: access tier for a warehouse dataset (public, internal, restricted), set in the infra change.

glossary.impact: Fixes how Claude reads every data-access thread.

evidence.quote: "Clearance levels are agreed. Sam applies the the infra change."

glossary.meaning: A monthly upper limit on billed usage per partner.

change.after: settlement cap: a monthly upper limit on billed usage per partner.

glossary.impact: billing threads become readable for Claude.

evidence.quote: "We need a settlement cap per partner, monthly."

fixes.issue: Brief listed the same PR twice
fixes.cause: Wrong or missing step: radar and Linear both report it, no de-duplication.
fixes.fix: Add a step to radar.md: merge items with the same link before writing the list.

change.before: ## 1. GitHub: pull requests that need the user
change.after:
## 0. De-duplicate
Before writing the list, merge items with the same link and keep the one with the stronger signal.

evidence.quote: friction.md: "2025-11-03 brief: PR #812 listed twice (GitHub and Linear) -> list once"
friction.md: "2025-11-04 brief: same PR twice again -> merge by link"

fixes.issue: Meeting prep used last year's agenda
fixes.cause: Missing context: recurring meetings share a title.
fixes.fix: Match the last meeting by series id, not by title.

change.before: Find the last meeting with the same title.
change.after: Find the last meeting in the same series (series id); fall back to the title.

fixes.impact: Affects prep for every recurring meeting.

evidence.quote: friction.md: "2025-11-04 prep for Roadmap review used last year's agenda -> use the last occurrence"

tips.tip: Write a short CLAUDE.md per folder for repeated rules
tips.why: Done signals already live there; one more line covers the receipts rule.

change.after:
Done signals: ...
Receipts: file to the finance folder, contractor bills as P0 task (see CLAUDE.md, Receipts).

tips.impact: Claude reads folder rules before it files an item.

evidence.quote: "Put the rules next to the files they affect, one short CLAUDE.md per folder."

tips.tip: Run the brief with a cheaper model for sorting
tips.why: Worth testing once the first week of runs is stable.

change.after: Sorting step: run with the cheaper model; summaries stay on the main model.

tips.impact: Cost per brief; no change to the page.

evidence.quote: "The sorting step does not need the big model."

tips.tip: Add a voice mode for captures
tips.impact: None: Claude would discard this tip.

evidence.quote: "Could we add a voice mode for captures?"

routines_new.title: Partner call follow-up
routines_new.trigger: A Demo recorder recording of a partner call lands
routines_new.output: pull signal logged, next step on the board, mail draft
routines_new.why: You did these three steps by hand after 3 calls this week.

change.after:
Trigger: Demo recorder recording of a partner call.
Steps: log pull signal, add next step to the board, draft the follow-up mail.

routines_new.impact: Saves the three manual steps after every partner call.

evidence.quote: Mon 3 Nov: pull signal logged, board task added, mail drafted by hand.
Tue 4 Nov: same three steps after the Northwind call.
Thu 6 Nov: same three steps again.

routines_new.title: Friday receipts batch
routines_new.output: receipts filed to the finance folder, contractor bills as P0 tasks

change.after: Trigger: Friday 2 PM. Receipts go to the finance folder; contractor bills become P0 tasks.

evidence.quote: Fri 31 Oct: sorted the receipts label by hand.
Fri 7 Nov: same sort.

plan_actual.note: Unplanned work took 9 hours, a quarter of the week. Leave 9 hours free next week.
